title: Portal
description: A door/gate. It joins two rooms of one instance, joins a room to the instance EXIT, or (with `link`) joins a room to another INSTANCE: a street door into a building, a stairwell between floors. `position` sits on the shared wall plane of both sides; `axis` is the wall normal; `size` is the opening [width, height].

roomA.description: Room id on the near side. Always a real room of this instance.

roomB.description: Room id on the other side; the literal "EXIT" for the instance exit; or the literal "LINK" when the far side is another instance (then `link` says which).

axis.description: Wall normal direction. The portal opening lies in the plane perpendicular to this axis.

link.description: Present exactly when roomB is "LINK". Walking into this portal moves play to another instance.

lock.description: Absent means always open. Present means the portal stays shut until map-state says its rule is satisfied.

blockId.description: The door is on the face of this block (a building standing in an open room) instead of on the room's own wall. Nothing is cut open: you reach the door and cross to the instance behind it.

allOf.description: roomB "LINK" and the `link` object imply each other.

spawnRoomId.description: Room to arrive in on the far side. Omitted means that instance's own spawn.

kind.description: What the door is, for signage and blueprint icons. Carries no rule.

rule.description: `all_cleared`: every required instance on the map is cleared (the rogue's exit gate). `cleared`: the single instance named by `instanceId` is cleared.

instanceId.description: Required by the `cleared` rule, unused by `all_cleared`.
